what: A thin band of light and shadow (the roller) bound to scroll passes from top to bottom over a large multi-line sentence, and only the lines the roller has passed are stamped onto the plate. Unstamped lines have a flat shadow and fade from left to right (per line .45→1 · .4→.8 · .35→.5 · .2→.45). The moment the roller crosses the center of a line, the shadow returns over a .09 share and sharpens over a .045 share. The roller starts .7 line-heights above and goes to .7 below, turning on and off in the first and last .06 share (no curve)

options.[data-fx-part=line]: Lines to stamp (two or more recommended) — the resting shadow is set by the consumer’s text-shadow
options.[data-fx-part=roller]: Roller (if absent, only the lines are stamped in turn) — height and side overflow are up to the consuming css
options.within: Pinned-plate selector (nearest ancestor), default nearest section — makes the plate 2.5 times the screen height and the inner stage position: sticky; to top: 0
options.start · end: Span, default top top · bottom bottom
options.pad: Distance the roller starts and ends outside the sentence (share of line height), default .7

use: Line oneLine two

from.where: index.html #craft .craft__statement — original scene:craft (press timeline: roller y, per-line textShadow flat→rest .09 · --lit .045, blur table fade)

note: Whether the panel attached to the panel (.fx-roller-on) has a fixed height is up to the user — on a shrunken screen, reducing only the panel height makes the same motion pass faster
